basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and Final Fantasy enthusiast based in Chicago. By day, I work as a software developer, and by night, I'm usually exploring various game worlds or tinkering with new coding projects. I enjoy sharing tips and strategies on gaming forums and have a soft spot for nostalgic games from the early 2000s. While I'm single, I love spending time with my close-knit group of friends, either online or at local meetups. My typical online hours are late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, with a degree from the University of Illinois. My expertise in gaming comes from years of playing various RPGs and strategy games, along with participating in online communities. I continue to expand my knowledge through self-teaching and engaging with other enthusiasts.
